answers.core:
Needs a rework of 2D camera.
___
Original issue: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/31153
answers.workaround: Technically it's possible to make a custom class inheriting Camera2D, but the issue is mora a usability problem that's more relevant for newly created 2D projects (as adding cameras is usually done on early stages), including prototypes.

title: Change Camera2D "current" property to "enabled" and make it true by default
